acceptanceStatement: leftover-join.v35 of G21 lands both frozen leftover-join.v34 of G21 findings exactly and completely. The MUST-FIX census contradiction is repaired in the direction the finding required, and the repaired recital was verified set-equal and order-equal to the true unrecorded set computed independently from live COORD headings rather than from the subject's own prose. The SHOULD-FIX v33 sweep is complete at all three named sites and was extended to the subject's own inbound landing. The delta against the frozen predecessor removes nothing, adds only the predecessor pins and the two disposition leaves, and changes nothing beyond the speaker advance and the two repairs. Every cited digest recomputes, every commit resolves, HEAD binds three ways, file 08 and COORD are unmoved at their dispatched digests, required-now 28 was recomputed from the register rather than accepted, and the D-354 remainder was checked against the four fixture files on disk. All twenty dispatch attacks are refuted. Six observations are recorded; none is a defect of this artifact and none rises to SHOULD-FIX.
